lines.t: {{ryoma}}
...Dang, I thought I'd finally
found the back entrance.
Back entrance...
What do you mean by that?
{{ryoma}}
The front entrance is on academy land.
Students are barred, so we can't get in.
But given the size of the mine,
it can't have been the only entrance.
Shafts probably ran all over the island,
with small entrances here and there.
With that in mind, I walked all over...
but I couldn't even find a trace.
This is the one I finally found. The rest
were buried when the mine shut, I bet.
{{mio}}
Bury them? Why go to the trouble?
What for?
{{ryoma}}
I don't know. But records from that time
never turn up, no matter how I search.
Maybe they have something to hide.
It must be connected to that accident...
An accident!
Does that mean--
{{ryoma}}
Shhh.
